title: Leave Salary Calculation In UAE
description: Discover briefly about leave salary calculation in UAE as per labour law. Understand the formula and information to figure out the steps.

Leave salary calculation in UAE is an important aspect of employment for both employees and employers. It is critical to understand how leave pay is calculated because it promotes financial openness, increases awareness of rights, and creates a positive work atmosphere.

This article delves into the subtleties of calculating leave salary in the United Arab Emirates, emphasizing its significance and effects on both individuals and companies.

What is Leave Salary Calculation In UAE?

The process of calculating leave salary in the UAE involves the complex combination of multiple intricate components, such as the employee’s base salary, the duration of the leave, and the type of leave being taken.

  • According to UAE labor laws, employees are granted a stipulated of 30 days of annual leave and an additional 15 days of sick leave per year. A meticulous understanding of this calculation is indispensable for both employees and employers to guarantee accurate payment, rights comprehension, and legal conformity.
  • The procedure entails the meticulous multiplication of the basic salary by the precise number of days on leave to ascertain the leave salary. In instances of termination or resignation, employees retain their entitlement to the accrued leave salary.

Essentially, exploring the complex processes involved in leave salary calculation in the United Arab Emirates is crucial to maintaining a positive workplace culture, making sure that legal requirements are strictly followed, and maintaining the honesty of compensation procedures.

How To Calculate Leave Salary In UAE?

Leave salary calculation in UAE is determined based on the employee’s total salary, encompassing the basic salary, housing allowance, and other standard allowances received during a typical working month.

  • As per UAE labor regulations, employees are granted 30 days of annual leave upon completing one year of service.
  • For employees with a tenure between six months and one year, they accrue two days of leave per month. The calculation involves remunerating the employee their full salary prior to the commencement of leave, taking into account their most recent salary payment.
  • Employers are obligated to settle the annual leave salary calculation in UAE before the leave period begins and must comply with specific guidelines.
  • Including providing a 10-day notice before the leave starts and allowing employees to select their preferred leave commencement date.

What is the duration of the leave in UAE?

  • The duration of leave entitlement in the UAE is directly linked to the employee’s tenure. After completing one year, employees are entitled to a comprehensive 30-day paid annual leave. Conversely, individuals with a service period of six months to a year receive two days of leave per month.
  • Additionally, employees can choose to carry over unused leave days with employer consent or receive a cash alternative.
  • These regulations guarantee employees both sufficient time off and equitable compensation, fostering work-life balance and improving overall employee well-being.

How is leave salary calculated in UAE?

  • Leave salary calculation in UAE is a meticulous process intricately linked to an employee’s total compensation. Including basic salary, housing allowance, and other standard benefits. This method correlates directly with the employee’s salary and annual leave duration.
  • Employers must strictly follow guidelines during this process. Ensuring employees receive their full salary for work before leave commences and annual leave compensation before the leave period starts.
  • The calculation considers the entire salary package, incorporating basic salary, housing allowance, and other regular allowances. Scenarios vary based on tenure: employees with 12 months of service. Taking a 30-day annual leave receive their full monthly salary divided by 30 days. Those terminating after a year receive basic salary only.
  • Employees with 6-12 months of service get two days of leave per month until a year. While those with less than 6 months receive no leave entitlement. Compliance with Article 29 of Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021 is crucial for transparent and fair annual leave compensation in the UAE.

Various Types of Leave in the UAE

Annual Leave

  • Eligibility: After completing 1 year of continuous service.

  • Duration:

    • 30 calendar days per year (after 1 year of service).

    • 2 days per month if service is between 6 months and 1 year.

Sick Leave

  • Eligibility: After the probation period.

  • Duration: Up to 90 days per year (continuous or intermittent).

Maternity Leave

  • Duration: 60 days total –

    • 45 days with full pay

    • 15 days with half pay

Paternity Leave

  • Duration: 5 working days.

Marriage Leave

  • Duration: 5 days.

Hajj or Umrah Leave

  • Duration: Up to 30 days unpaid leave (for performing Hajj).

Venturing into the realm of a 30-day annual leave post 12 months of dedicated service unveils a labyrinthine equation. However, the leave salary calculation formula in UAE for this calculation dances around dividing the sum of basic salary and allowances by 30. Then multiplying it by the number of days on leave.

Conversely, when facing the termination of employment after a year. The calculation simplifies to revolve solely around the individual’s basic salary. Shedding light on the nuanced variations within UAE leave salary calculation computations.

Amidst this intricate dance of leave salary intricacies, workers find themselves navigating through a regulatory maze outlined by the UAE Labor Law.

Employers orchestrate leave dates based on operational needs or mutual agreements with employees. With a mandatory one-month notice period preceding the leave date.

Furthermore, employees hold the reins to choose their leave commencement with a prerequisite 10-day notice. The flexibility extends to carrying over unused annual leave to subsequent years with employer consent. Adding bursts of dynamism to an otherwise structured framework.

FAQs:

What is the leave salary in the UAE?

Leave salary in the UAE is the payment employees receive during their annual leave, ensuring they earn income while taking time off as per UAE Labour Law.

What is the formula for calculating leave salary?

Leave salary is typically calculated using the formula: (Basic Salary ÷ 30) × Number of leave days.

Is leave salary calculated on basic salary or full salary?

Leave salary in the UAE is usually based on the employee’s basic salary, but companies can choose to include allowances depending on their policy or contract terms.

How many days of annual leave are employees entitled to in the UAE?

Employees who have completed one year of service are entitled to 30 calendar days of paid annual leave.

What happens if an employee takes unpaid leave?

If an employee takes unpaid leave, that duration is deducted from the total salary for the month and does not count toward annual leave or service benefits.
